quote: The birth of beBird stands on the shoulders of many open-source giants. We are grateful for the contributions of the following outstanding resources and communities.

itemQuote.leaflet: The core open-source JavaScript engine powering beBird's interactive map experience, lightweight and highly performant.
itemQuote.ebird: Provides the core global bird observation data for our site, serving as the cornerstone for ecological exploration.
itemQuote.tomorrow: Delivers high-precision real-time weather and forecast data, helping birders plan trips under optimal weather conditions.
itemQuote.sunrise: A lightweight and reliable sunrise and sunset time calculation service, making dawn and dusk observation plans more precise.
itemQuote.nominatim: Provides reliable reverse geocoding services, converting coordinates into detailed address and region information.
itemQuote.flaticon: Animated icons that add vitality to the weather information panel.
itemQuote.lovart: A high-quality source of artistic design assets that gives the website its unique visual style and texture.
